# GAOS v1.0.0 — stable complete Game-Agent Open Standard SDK

GAOS v1.0 freezes the complete product-neutral SDK. It includes every
implemented roadmap item through RFC-022 without publishing intermediate
v0.27 or v0.29 packages.

## Included

- Portal-aware deterministic pathfinding with a separate authoritative transit
  boundary.
- One durable create/attach, observe/act, finalize, and close lifecycle for
  normal play, agents, presentation, and benchmarks.
- Unified behavior-tree, human-input, and agent-input control sources.
- Reproducible benchmark publication with explicitly self-reported token,
  cost, timing, and provider observations.
- Product-owned historical verifier kits and independently pinned trust.
- Product-owned command classification with unified intent and interaction
  effects, deterministic recovery, and replay v1.4 interaction records.
- Provider-neutral room agents, audience interaction, and durable streamed
  runs with atomic admission, ordered journals, checkpoints, continuation,
  cancellation, deadlines, and crash recovery.
- Ordered, idempotent presentation cues for browser and native renderers.
- Reviewed API reports, coverage and mutation floors, cross-runtime
  deterministic-math checks, and package smoke tests.

## Breaking migration

The deprecated v0.12 grid-named aliases are removed. Use `SubmittedAction`,
`ActionDefinition`, `solveLevel`, `enumerateActions`, `SolveResult`,
`SolverOptions`, `recheckTranscript`, `RecheckResult`, `TranscriptAction`, and
`TranscriptHeader`.

The canonical package names remain `@yugao-gaos/gaos-sdk` and `gaos-sdk`
(`gaos_sdk` import). `gaos.ticks` v1 and historical `gaos.replay` v1.0–v1.3
retain their documented interpretation. Sessions with unified interaction
effects emit replay v1.4 records while signatures, verifier-kit identities,
and evidence semantics remain compatible.

## Release-candidate validation

- Node 22: 462 tests, typecheck, architecture, API-surface, documentation,
  deterministic evidence, and install-from-archive smoke gates pass.
- TypeScript coverage: 80.41% statements, 74.22% branches, 90.12% functions,
  and 82.48% lines.
- Python: 82 tests and 67.80% branch-aware coverage; wheel and source archives
  build as version 1.0.0.
- Mutation scores: TypeScript 65.35% (63% floor) and Python 82.77% (82% floor).
- Deterministic math passes in Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and workerd.
- Signature verification measured 1.098 ms per verification in the local
  release run. Observation-codec scenarios remained within the 50 ms tick
  budget, including the 500-entity adaptive probe.
- The simulated two-hour 20 Hz durable-session test remains green.

The protected-branch matrix, exact-tag independent consumer run, rollback
owner, compatibility reviewer, and final GO are recorded on the release pull
request before publication.
